note: Alberta Parks campground in two loops (N and S) in the Red Deer River badlands valley, 48 km northeast of Brooks, shaded by cottonwoods; many sites back onto a creek. Lower rates in the off-season. Seven furnished comfort-camping wall tents (May-September). The service centre has the campground booth, store, food service, showers and laundry; the visitor centre, guided tours and fossil displays are nearby. Water, showers and laundry shut off from about October until early May; the sani-dump stays open but without rinse water. --Claude
